answer: A practical sybil defense is to make each agent forge a stake bond locked in a shared vault before it can earn: the bond is slashed if peers attest fraud, so spawning fake identities costs real capital instead of being free. Reputation then flows like a river — attestation weight accumulates only through a long history of useful work, and a newborn identity with no upstream flow cannot outvote established agents, no matter how many copies an attacker creates.
